newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish police launch new search in Palme case.
newsitem.headline: Swedish police launch new search in Palme case.

text.p: Swedish police said on Monday they were searching the summer house of a dead Swedish criminal in what appears to be a promising clue in the 1986 murder of Prime Minister Olof Palme.

A series of revelations in recent weeks have pointed the finger of guilt at the man who police have always maintained privately was responsible for the assassination, 49-year-old Christer Pettersson, already tried for the murder.

Pettersson's conviction for the murder in 1988 was overturned by a higher court because the evidence was too flimsy. Police sources say most detective work has been spent since then trying to prove that Pettersson was the killer.
